QuestInfo.name: Support for Lv. 100 Resistance members.
QuestInfo.0: #bCassandra#k will give a gift to Resistance members who've reached Lv. 100, but it's her last one! Go see Cassandra once you reach Lv. 100.
QuestInfo.2: You received an item that will help your development, but it can't be used yet. You must wait until Jan 19.

0.0: #eLevel 100!#n\nAmazing! You deserve a gift as congratulations for reaching Level 100, so please come and see me.

yes.0: All right then! I, Cassandra, will be waiting in town as always.

no.0: The gift event will be going on until Jan 18, so please come see me anytime.

1.0: This is a special bonus EXP item that will be available to all jobs starting #bJan 19#k. This item will help you gain EXP. You must remember to check the expiration date. Also keep in mind that you cannot use it more than #r7 times#k, which includes the number of Energy Capsules used.
1.1: This is the last gift I'll give you... I'm honored that I was able to observe you throughout your growth!
